purpose: Research shortlist for possible historical illustration and ornament additions; not an asset catalog, resource assignment, or publication approval.
method: Locate motifs through museum decoration inventories, object records and curated selections, then inspect selected images. No sequential manuscript scanning.
scope: Prefer historical originals and image terms allowing modification, redistribution and commercial use. Keep attractive restricted scans as references for independently authored adaptations or an alternative unrestricted reproduction.

discovery_guides.title: Walters W.102 decoration inventory
discovery_guides.use: Lists named motifs and exact folios, including the Reynard funeral cycle and line fillers.

discovery_guides.title: Music in the Margins: The Funeral of Reynard the Fox
discovery_guides.use: Curated detail images; confirm identification against Walters because the elephant-pilgrim caption gives 73r while the museum inventory gives 73v.

discovery_guides.title: Renaissance Ornament Prints and Drawings
discovery_guides.use: Curated scholarly discovery guide with links to original collection objects. Use the historical objects' open images, not presumed reuse rights in the modern publication.

candidates.title: Rabbit tolling church bells
candidates.discovery: Named in the museum's folio decoration inventory; also in the curated Reynard funeral selection.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected the detail distributed by the museum's Flickr account.
candidates.proposed_use: Standalone illustration retaining the rabbit, rope and church as one composition.
candidates.fit: Extends existing rabbit musicians with a new action and an architectural scene.
candidates.work_needed: Obtain the highest useful source resolution and remove parchment carefully. The bell rope joins the church; extracting only the rabbit would lose the action.

candidates.title: Horse playing a flute and drum
candidates.discovery: Museum decoration inventory and curated Reynard funeral selection.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected the selected detail: an upright blue horse-like animal plays a pipe beside a round red-rimmed drum. Source text is above, and a small green ground strip is below; extraction fidelity is not yet assessed.
candidates.proposed_use: Single-figure illustration with both instruments retained.
candidates.fit: Adds a horse musician and a combined flute-and-drum action absent from the current illustration descriptions.
candidates.work_needed: Inspect the full-resolution museum master and retain the entire figure and instruments during extraction.

candidates.title: Centaur firing an arrow
candidates.discovery: Named in the museum's decoration inventory.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected the museum-distributed detail: blue equine body, pale human torso and red bow, with green ground beneath.
candidates.fit: Adds a centaur and archery to a collection currently concentrated on music and reading.
candidates.work_needed: Acquire a release-quality source; preserve the fine bowstring and arrow. Decide explicitly whether the green ground remains.

candidates.title: Elephant and castle
candidates.discovery: Museum inventory identifies the motif as a line filler; the object record also lists its inclusion in Getty's Book of Beasts exhibition.
candidates.visual_review: Object and rights verified; image inspection pending.
candidates.proposed_use: Standalone illustration or complete figural line decoration.
candidates.fit: Adds an elephant and a distinctive animal-and-architecture motif.
candidates.work_needed: Inspect its relationship to the surrounding line and lettering before choosing extraction bounds. Keep elephant and castle together; do not assume repeat capability.

candidates.title: Sheet of border segments: vertical floral ornament, horizontal frieze, four corners
candidates.discovery: Linked from the museum's curated Renaissance Ornament Prints and Drawings publication.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected the source image: two long ornament strips and four separately framed roundel blocks. The title's four corners are not a ready-made modern frame atlas.
candidates.proposed_use: Separate long decorations and roundels initially; repeating borders only after geometry and join review.
candidates.fit: Historical modular ornament with actual strip and corner-related components; unusually close to the library's needs.
candidates.work_needed: Retain distinctions between the two strips and the roundels. Audit source repeat periods, end phases and any adaptations needed for a frame. Preserve source scans; document tracing or reconstruction.

candidates.title: Horizontal Panel with Two Tendrils Sprouting from the Center, Ending in Volutes
candidates.visual_review: Inspected: light foliate scrolls on dark engraving hatching, spreading outward from a central stem; artist monogram at the bottom.
candidates.fit: A compact Renaissance scrollwork panel suitable above or below content.
candidates.work_needed: Preserve the complete centered composition. An SVG trace would be an adaptation of the engraving; removing hatching would change its appearance. No seamless repeat claim.

candidates.title: Ornamental Fillet with Thistle Motifs
candidates.discovery: Linked from the museum's curated Renaissance ornament publication.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected: dense upright botanical ornament, curling stems, birds or fantastic bird-like figures, and a mask near the bottom.
candidates.fit: Adds dense black-and-white Renaissance botanical and fantastic ornament.
candidates.work_needed: Keep the complete panel first. Do not infer a tile from the word fillet; the image has a composed beginning and end.

candidates.title: Floral border surrounding Virgin and Christ with Angels
candidates.artist: Master of the First Prayerbook of Maximillian and associates
candidates.discovery: Cataloged leaf with an explicit description of the flowers, birds and butterflies in its border.
candidates.visual_review: Museum description and image terms verified; source download blocked in this session, so visual extraction review remains pending.
candidates.proposed_use: Whole floral border, side decorations, or individual flower and butterfly illustrations after source inspection.
candidates.fit: Close match to the library's painted botanical ornaments, with naturalistic fauna.
candidates.work_needed: Inspect the source at full resolution. Preserve or explicitly adapt the gold ground; document any removal of the central scene. The composition is not presumed seamless.

candidates.title: French Rose and Apple
candidates.artist: Georg Bocskay, script; Joris Hoefnagel, illumination
candidates.discovery: Museum curator's illustrated article identifies this exact folio.
candidates.image_reuse: Getty Open Content / CC0; institutional manuscript policy verified. Obtain the Open Content master and preserve its designation at acquisition.
candidates.visual_review: Inspected: two pink roses and a cut apple below calligraphy, plus a complete intricate black strapwork-and-vine frame.
candidates.proposed_use: Rose-and-apple botanical illustration and, separately, a whole strapwork frame decoration.
candidates.fit: One located page offers both a painted botanical composition and geometric scrollwork.
candidates.work_needed: Acquire the designated Open Content master. Keep the fruit and flower composition whole initially. Removing text or converting the frame to a stretchable atlas requires documented adaptation.

candidates.title: Rabbit blowing a hunting horn and riding a hound
candidates.discovery: Exact folio and motif described by the museum's Illuminated project.
candidates.image_reuse: Reference only; website images declared CC BY-NC-ND. The collections API describes CC BY-NC-SA images instead; neither is unrestricted for our intended redistribution.
candidates.visual_review: Catalog identification verified; image review deferred because this is not a direct-use candidate.
candidates.proposed_use: Reference for an independently authored adaptation of the historical motif, or locate an unrestricted reproduction of the original artwork.
candidates.fit: A new rabbit action involving a hound, fitting the animal and fantasy categories.
candidates.work_needed: Do not publish a cropped, traced or AI-edited restricted scan as an unrestricted cutout. A new drawing must have its own documented method and must not be represented as source pixels. Resolve any applicable source-use terms before authoring.
